record.original_question: Find an order-theoretic characterization of Scott well-filtered dcpos, where a dcpo P is Scott well-filtered exactly when its Scott space Sigma P is well-filtered.

evidence.quote: Question 4.5. Find an order characterization for Scott well-filtered dcpos (cf. the first problem below [19, Exercise VII-1.14]).
Definition 4.4. Let P be a dcpo. (2) P is said to be Scott well-filtered if SigmaP is well-filtered.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Background and definitions.

Let $P$ be a poset. A nonempty subset $D \subseteq P$ is directed if every pair of elements of $D$ has an upper bound in $D$. A poset $P$ is a directed-complete partial order (dcpo) if every directed subset $D \subseteq P$ has a least upper bound $\bigvee D$ in $P$.

A subset $U$ of a dcpo $P$ is Scott open if (i) $U$ is an upper set, i.e. $x \in U$ and $x \leq y$ imply $y \in U$, and (ii) for every directed $D \subseteq P$ with $\bigvee D \in U$, there exists $d \in D$ with $d \in U$. The collection of Scott-open sets forms a topology on $P$, called the Scott topology; the resulting topological space is denoted $\Sigma P$.

A subset $K$ of a topological space $X$ is saturated if it equals the intersection of its open neighborhoods (equivalently, $K$ is an upper set in the specialization preorder). A topological space $X$ is well-filtered if for every filtered family $\{K_i\}_{i \in I}$ of nonempty compact saturated subsets of $X$ (filtered meaning that for any $i, j \in I$ there exists $k \in I$ with $K_k \subseteq K_i \cap K_j$) and every open set $U \subseteq X$ such that $\bigcap_{i \in I} K_i \subseteq U$, there exists some $i_0 \in I$ with $K_{i_0} \subseteq U$.

A dcpo $P$ is called Scott well-filtered if its Scott space $\Sigma P$ is a well-filtered topological space.

Problem.

Provide a purely order-theoretic characterization of Scott well-filtered dcpos: namely, formulate a condition on a dcpo $P$, expressed only in terms of the order $\leq$ on $P$ (without reference to the Scott topology, compact saturated sets, or other topological notions), that is equivalent to $\Sigma P$ being well-filtered.
artifact.status_search_result: Searches indicate this is an active area in domain theory. Related questions (e.g. whether well-filtered Scott spaces of dcpos are sober) have been resolved negatively via counterexamples (Kou; Jia), but a purely order-theoretic characterization of Scott well-filtered dcpos analogous to that of dcpos with sober Scott topology does not appear to have been established in the available literature. The status thus appears to remain open, though no definitive solved/unsolved declaration was found.

status_evidence.title: A new dcpo whose Scott topology is well-filtered but not sober
status_evidence.snippet: Heckmann asked whether the Scott topology of a dcpo is sober if it is well-filtered; Kou gave a counterexample, and simpler examples have followed.
status_evidence.claim: Related questions on well-filtered Scott topologies of dcpos have been resolved, but an order characterization of Scott well-filteredness is not stated.

status_evidence.title: X. Jia's well-filtered, non-sober dcpo
status_evidence.snippet: Discussion of well-filtered but non-sober dcpos in domain theory.
status_evidence.claim: Continuing research on well-filtered dcpos suggests no settled order characterization.
